description: Who may write contact-organization memberships (sprk_contactorganization). Owner decision 2026-10-28 (issue #2382): contact-organization membership writes move to the Access Administrator role. The writer role holds Create, Read, Write and Append at Global; the listed user roles keep Read only (Share is left as it is: without Write it confers nothing). tests/Spaarke.ArchTests/ContactOrganizationMembershipWriterGuardTests.cs checks the role XML; scripts/Set-WizardLinkingAndMembershipPrivileges.ps1 applies it to an environment.
